title: perf(canary): add automated latency/throughput regression detector and rollout guards
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Context: We've seen intermittent latency regressions that only show up under production traffic patterns; manual detection is slow and rollouts sometimes expose customers. This PR adds an automated performance canary detector that continuously monitors rolling-percentile latency and throughput metrics for canary slices and enforces rollout guards when regressions are detected. Motivation: reduce time-to-detect, prevent bad rollouts, and make canary decisions deterministic and auditable. Changes: - New detector implemented in perf-canary/detector/detector.py: rolling-window percentile detector (p50/p95/p99) + throughput drift detection + KV-cache-aware baseline subtraction. - Adaptive hysteresis algorithm in perf-canary/rollout/guards.py to avoid flapping during transient noise. - CI integration: infra/ci/perf-canary.yml adds nightly canary benchmark job and a quick pre-merge smoke run. - Tests: perf-canary/tests/test_detector.py covers synthetic regressions, hysteresis, and recovery logic. - Runtime changes: small instrumentation in redwood-runtime/scheduler/batcher.cpp to emit batch size and queue latency metrics used by the detector. - Docs: docs/perf-canary.md explains thresholds, Linear link, and how to interpret detector alerts. Rollout behavior: - Detector computes delta vs rolling baseline using exponentially-weighted windows and flags a regression when (latency_delta >= threshold AND throughput_drop >= threshold) for N consecutive windows (configurable). - Guards will automatically halt traffic promotion and post an incident-style comment with detected metric deltas, sample traces, and suggested mitigations (fallback to previous model variant, reduce concurrency). - Operator controls: feature flag (perf.canary.autodetect) + per-model override in console. Testing & validation checklist: - [x] unit tests for detector logic - [x] integration tests for guard decision path - [x] CI job added to run fast benchmark on push - [x] manual canary run on staging - [x] docs updated Follow-ups: e2e canary run with live traffic profiles (ENG-2120), add anomaly score to incident runbooks, and add Prometheus exporter for detector decisions. Related: Linear ENG-2104, ENG-2120. Notes: conservative defaults chosen to avoid false-positives; hysteresis uses longer decay on ramp-ups than ramp-downs. CI/observability: detector emits events to perf-canary index (with trace id), and Console UI will render canary decision timeline.
